notes.totalChars: 8105 is the full character universe tracked by the content pipeline (data/general-standard-chinese-characters.json). Only 7909 of those have an importable data/content/<char>.json file: 196 are 4-byte UTF-8 characters that mysql2's binary protocol cannot write, so the DB seed targets importableChars, not totalChars.
notes.byField: Each byField value counts files under data/content/ that actually carry that field, never totalChars.
notes.rare_meaning: byField.rare_meaning and byField.rare_story count every content file with a non-empty rare.meaning/rare.story (1412). The DB importer initRareChars() additionally requires level === 3, so it writes 1409 rows. The 3-character difference is expected, not a data loss; seed-registry expects 1409.
notes.generatedAt: Timestamp of the last byField recomputation (scripts/update-content-manifest.ts).
